messages:
rachael_cs: Heads up  NimbleAnalytics Dedicated bring-up tomorrow 11:00am PT. Focus: quota signoff, autoscale smoke, 20m canary + short stress spike. Please confirm owners.

devon_eng: I'll own the model variant and perf checks. Which model and token targets?

rachael_cs: Model: rwd-embed-chat-8k:q5:v1 pinned. Targets: steady ~18 RPS (mixed chat), ~1300 tok/s. Canary: 10m at 6 RPS, 60s spike to 35 RPS, then steady 20m at 18 RPS.

amir_ops: Using autoscale policy nimble-autoscale-v2: min_instances=2, max_instances=12, scale_up_if_gpu>75% for 120s. We'll enable burst +3 during spike window. Ops oncall for manual bump.

kai_sre: I'll add alerts: p95>220ms or p99>420ms -> notify; error_rate>0.8% -> auto-failover to hosted-fallback. Also monitoring cache-eviction and kv-hit-rate. If p99 breaches for 2 consecutive 5m windows, we pause and rollback.

devon_eng: Perf runner: small locust script. Ramp plan included in thread. We'll run priming 25m prior: low-rate priming of top 60 prompts to warm KV.

leah_cust: I'll join. Important: our renewal committee expects a good-faith burn estimate. If cost delta >12% vs forecast, we escalate. Please record per-route token counts.

rachael_cs: Actions: 1) devon 6 perf: push locust and priming payloads. 2) amir: set nimble-autoscale-v2 + burst. 3) kai: dashboards + alerts + rollback hooks. 4) leah: provide top prompts and expected monthly tokens. Final sync 10:40am PT in #customer-success.

deploy-bot: Scheduled job created: nimble-canary-1746000000 at 2024-08-01T18:00:00Z (canary window 30m). Owner: devon_eng.

devon_eng: I'll post CSV summary and a short perf note after run. If we see tail latency regression on q5, I'll test q5-latency-flag variant and report.

amir_ops: Ops will watch for sustained GPU util >82% for 3m; manual +2 nodes available. Otherwise autoscale will handle.

leah_cust: We'll fill the feedback form and attach a short bullet list for the renewal team. Thanks everyone.

kai_sre: I'll open an incident channel automatically if we hit rollback and drop the postmortem link in here.

devon_eng: Priming snippet (excerpt):

POST /v1/cache/prime
{"model":"rwd-embed-chat-8k:q5:v1","prompts":["<top_prompt_1>","<top_prompt_2>"]}

rachael_cs: Thanks all  see you at 10:40am. :thumbsup:
